title: Valid Parentheses
description: Push opening brackets. For each closing bracket, pop and check the matching opener.
note: The stack stores char values. Its element type is inferred from the values pushed onto it.
notes: Reject a closing bracket if the stack is empty or the brackets disagree.
The input is assumed to contain only ()[]{} characters. At the end, an empty stack means all brackets were matched. Birdie uses a dedicated stack type; Python uses a list with append and pop.
